fills: the occasion bullets at the end of each Do and Don't list
formula: Do: an imperative verb and the content it is about, naming a component where one fits
Don't: start with 'Do not', the tempting mistake, then ' — ' and why
rules: exactly one bullet per supplied intent, in order
content only: what the page says, never how it looks
